t.en: Preparing: ghusl, siwak, perfume, best clothes
t.ms: Persiapan: mandi, bersugi, wangian, pakaian terbaik

s.en: He said: "Whoever of you comes to the Jumu'ah, let him bathe" (al-Bukhari 877), and that the Friday bath is due on every adult, with siwak and perfume if he has it (al-Bukhari 880). Whoever bathes, cleans himself, uses oil or perfume, goes without separating two people, prays what is written for him and listens when the imam speaks, has his sins forgiven until the next Friday (al-Bukhari 883).
s.ms: Baginda bersabda: "Sesiapa di antara kamu datang ke solat Jumaat, hendaklah dia mandi" (al-Bukhari 877), dan mandi Jumaat itu wajib atas setiap orang yang baligh, berserta bersugi dan memakai wangian jika ada (al-Bukhari 880). Sesiapa yang mandi, membersihkan diri, memakai minyak atau wangian, pergi tanpa memisahkan dua orang, solat apa yang ditetapkan untuknya dan diam mendengar ketika imam berkhutbah, diampunkan dosanya hingga Jumaat berikutnya (al-Bukhari 883).

t.en: Going early, and what to do while waiting
t.ms: Pergi awal, dan apa yang dilakukan sementara menunggu

s.en: Going in the first hour is like offering a camel, then a cow, a ram, a hen and an egg; when the imam comes out the angels close their records and listen (al-Bukhari 881). Pray what Allah wills before the imam comes (al-Bukhari 883; Muslim 1987). Do not step over people's necks (Abu Dawud 1118). Send much salawat on the Prophet ﷺ on Friday (Abu Dawud 1047). Reading Surah al-Kahf on Friday: "a light between the two Fridays" (al-Hakim, al-Bayhaqi; not in this app's books; al-Albani: sahih).
s.ms: Pergi pada saat pertama seperti berkorban seekor unta, kemudian lembu, kibas, ayam dan telur; apabila imam keluar, malaikat menutup catatan mereka dan mendengar (al-Bukhari 881). Solatlah apa yang Allah kehendaki sebelum imam datang (al-Bukhari 883; Muslim 1987). Jangan melangkahi bahu orang (Abu Dawud 1118). Perbanyakkan selawat ke atas Nabi ﷺ pada hari Jumaat (Abu Dawud 1047). Membaca Surah al-Kahf pada hari Jumaat: "cahaya antara dua Jumaat" (al-Hakim, al-Baihaqi; tiada dalam kitab aplikasi ini; al-Albani: sahih).

h.en: Send much salawat on me on Friday
h.ms: Perbanyakkan selawat ke atasku pada hari Jumaat

src: al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 6470 and Sahih at-Targhib 736 (Surah al-Kahf on Friday): sahih

s.en: In the time of the Prophet ﷺ, Abu Bakr and 'Umar there was one adhan, when the imam sat on the minbar; 'Uthman added another call at az-Zawra' when the people increased (al-Bukhari 912). After that adhan the khutbah began, so there was no time between the adhan and the khutbah for a prayer. Ibn 'Umar described the Prophet's sunnah prayers: two after Jumu'ah in his house, and none before it is mentioned (al-Bukhari 937; Muslim 2040). Praying freely before the imam comes is encouraged (al-Bukhari 883). Whether there is a fixed 'qabliyyah' sunnah, like the one before Zuhr, is where scholars differ.
s.ms: Pada zaman Nabi ﷺ, Abu Bakar dan Umar hanya ada satu azan, iaitu ketika imam duduk di atas mimbar; Uthman menambah satu seruan lagi di az-Zawra' apabila orang ramai bertambah (al-Bukhari 912). Selepas azan itu khutbah terus bermula, maka tiada masa antara azan dan khutbah untuk solat. Ibn Umar menyebut solat sunat Nabi: dua rakaat selepas Jumaat di rumahnya, dan tidak disebut solat sebelumnya (al-Bukhari 937; Muslim 2040). Solat sunat mutlak sebelum imam datang digalakkan (al-Bukhari 883). Sama ada ada solat sunat qabliyah Jumaat yang tetap, seperti sebelum Zuhur, di situlah ulama berbeza.

h.en: One adhan, when the imam sat on the minbar
h.ms: Satu azan, ketika imam duduk di atas mimbar

topic.en: Is there a fixed sunnah prayer before Jumu'ah?
topic.ms: Adakah solat sunat tetap sebelum Jumaat?

p.en: Yes: like the sunnah before Zuhr, at least two rak'ahs before and two after; the Shafi'i view with the stronger evidence.
p.ms: Ya: seperti sunat sebelum Zuhur, sekurang-kurangnya dua rakaat sebelum dan dua selepas; pendapat Syafi'i yang lebih kuat dalilnya.
p.ref: al-Khatib asy-Syirbini, Mughni al-Muhtaj 1/220 (cited by Dar al-Ifta al-Misriyyah, fatwa 4358)

p.en: Yes: four rak'ahs before Jumu'ah and four after.
p.ms: Ya: empat rakaat sebelum Jumaat dan empat selepasnya.
p.ref: Ibn 'Abidin, Radd al-Muhtar 1/452 (cited by Dar al-Ifta al-Misriyyah, fatwa 4358)

p.en: No fixed sunnah for Jumu'ah, but voluntary prayer before it is allowed.
p.ms: Tiada sunat tetap bagi Jumaat, tetapi solat sunat mutlak sebelumnya dibolehkan.
p.ref: Ibn Shas, 'Aqd al-Jawahir ath-Thaminah 1/133 (cited by Dar al-Ifta al-Misriyyah, fatwa 4358)

p.en: Two reports from Ahmad (two or four rak'ahs, or none); the better-known view in the school is that there is no fixed sunnah before it.
p.ms: Dua riwayat daripada Ahmad (dua atau empat rakaat, atau tiada); pendapat yang lebih masyhur dalam mazhab ialah tiada sunat tetap sebelumnya.
p.ref: al-Mardawi, al-Insaf 5/266-267 (cited by Dar al-Ifta al-Misriyyah, fatwa 4358); Irsyad al-Fatwa 67, Mufti Wilayah Persekutuan

p.en: There is no sunnah before Jumu'ah: the Prophet ﷺ came out, the adhan was called, and he gave the khutbah.
p.ms: Tiada solat sunat sebelum Jumaat: Nabi ﷺ keluar, azan dilaungkan, lalu Baginda berkhutbah.
p.ref: Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmu' al-Fatawa 24/189 (as cited by IslamQA 301470)

p.en: "As for the sunnah before Jumu'ah, nothing about it is established."
p.ms: "Adapun sunat sebelum Jumaat, tiada apa-apa yang sabit mengenainya."
p.ref: Ibn Hajar al-'Asqalani, Fath al-Bari 2/410 (as cited by IslamQA 301470)

p.en: The sunnah before Jumu'ah is legislated and recommended, from the hadith "between every two adhans there is a prayer" and others; calling it an innovation is wrong.
p.ms: Sunat sebelum Jumaat disyariatkan dan digalakkan, berdalilkan hadis "antara setiap dua azan ada solat" dan lain-lain; menyebutnya bid'ah adalah salah.

p.ref: Pejabat Mufti Wilayah Persekutuan, Irsyad al-Fatwa 67 (12 Aug 2015)

h.en: "Between every two adhans there is a prayer" (for whoever wishes)
h.ms: "Antara setiap dua azan ada solat" (bagi sesiapa yang mahu)

h.en: Ibn 'Umar prayed long before Jumu'ah and two rak'ahs after it at home, and said the Prophet ﷺ did that
h.ms: Ibn Umar solat panjang sebelum Jumaat dan dua rakaat selepasnya di rumah, dan berkata Nabi ﷺ melakukannya

h.en: "He prayed four before Jumu'ah": very weak (al-Albani), weak isnad (al-Arna'ut)
h.ms: "Baginda solat empat rakaat sebelum Jumaat": sangat lemah (al-Albani), sanad lemah (al-Arna'ut)

note.en: No authentic report shows the Prophet ﷺ or the Companions standing up to pray after the Friday adhan, as many do in the Nusantara after the first adhan: in their time the only adhan was when the imam sat on the minbar, and the khutbah followed it. The first (earlier) adhan in mosques today is the one 'Uthman added. Those who hold a qabliyyah take it from "between every two adhans there is a prayer" and from the sunnah before Zuhr; those who do not, from the absence of any report. The hadith "he prayed four before Jumu'ah" (Ibn Majah 1129) is very weak. Both sides agree that praying voluntarily before the imam comes out is good. Follow your teacher and do not make it a cause of dispute.
note.ms: Tiada riwayat sahih yang menunjukkan Nabi ﷺ atau para Sahabat bangun solat selepas azan Jumaat, seperti yang dilakukan ramai di Nusantara selepas azan pertama: pada zaman mereka satu-satunya azan ialah ketika imam duduk di atas mimbar, dan khutbah terus menyusul. Azan pertama (lebih awal) di masjid hari ini ialah yang ditambah oleh Uthman. Yang berpendapat ada qabliyah berdalilkan "antara setiap dua azan ada solat" dan sunat sebelum Zuhur; yang tidak, kerana tiada riwayat mengenainya. Hadis "Baginda solat empat rakaat sebelum Jumaat" (Ibn Majah 1129) sangat lemah. Kedua-dua pihak sepakat solat sunat mutlak sebelum imam keluar adalah baik. Ikut guru anda dan jangan jadikannya punca perselisihan.

s.en: He gave two khutbahs standing, sitting between them (al-Bukhari 920; Muslim 1996), reciting the Qur'an and exhorting the people (Muslim 1995). Saying to your neighbour "be quiet" while the imam is speaking is idle talk (al-Bukhari 934). A man who came in and sat was told to stand and pray two short rak'ahs (al-Bukhari 930; Muslim 2023). Sitting hugging the knees during the khutbah was forbidden (Abu Dawud 1110).
s.ms: Baginda menyampaikan dua khutbah sambil berdiri, dan duduk di antara keduanya (al-Bukhari 920; Muslim 1996), membaca al-Quran dan memberi peringatan kepada orang ramai (Muslim 1995). Berkata kepada orang di sebelah "diam" ketika imam berkhutbah adalah perkara sia-sia (al-Bukhari 934). Seorang lelaki yang masuk lalu duduk disuruh bangun dan solat dua rakaat yang ringkas (al-Bukhari 930; Muslim 2023). Duduk memeluk lutut ketika khutbah dilarang (Abu Dawud 1110).

p.en: Five: praising Allah, salawat on the Prophet ﷺ and exhorting to taqwa, in each of the two khutbahs; reciting an ayah in one of them; and du'a for the believers in the second.
p.ms: Lima: memuji Allah, selawat ke atas Nabi ﷺ dan berpesan dengan taqwa, dalam kedua-dua khutbah; membaca satu ayat dalam salah satunya; dan doa untuk orang beriman dalam khutbah kedua.
p.ref: al-Nawawi, Rawdat at-Talibin 2/24-25; Hashiyata Qalyubi wa 'Umayrah 1/321

p.en: Abu Hanifah: any remembrance of Allah is enough, even a short one; his two companions Abu Yusuf and Muhammad: it must be a long remembrance that is called a khutbah.
p.ms: Abu Hanifah: apa-apa zikir kepada Allah sudah memadai, walaupun pendek; dua sahabatnya Abu Yusuf dan Muhammad: mesti zikir yang panjang yang dinamakan khutbah.
p.ref: Ibn Qutlubugha, at-Tashih wat-Tarjih 'ala Mukhtasar al-Quduri p. 184

p.en: What the Arabs would call a khutbah; both khutbahs are a condition, in the school's well-known view.
p.ms: Apa yang dinamakan khutbah oleh orang Arab; kedua-dua khutbah adalah syarat, menurut pendapat masyhur mazhab.
p.ref: Ibn 'Abd al-Barr, al-Kafi 1/251; ad-Dardir, ash-Sharh al-Kabir 1/378; al-Kharashi, Sharh Mukhtasar Khalil 5/175

p.en: Four in each khutbah: praising Allah, salawat on the Prophet ﷺ, reciting at least one complete ayah, and exhorting to taqwa.
p.ms: Empat dalam setiap khutbah: memuji Allah, selawat ke atas Nabi ﷺ, membaca sekurang-kurangnya satu ayat yang lengkap, dan berpesan dengan taqwa.
p.ref: Ibn Qudamah, al-Kafi 1/328 (exhortation); Hanbali summary by Shaykh Zahed Fettah, IslamQA.org

p.en: It must be what is called a khutbah by custom: only blaming this world and mentioning death is not enough.
p.ms: Ia mesti apa yang dinamakan khutbah menurut uruf: sekadar mencela dunia dan menyebut kematian tidak memadai.

t.en: The sitting between the two khutbahs

s.en: He sat between the two khutbahs (al-Bukhari 920; Muslim 1996). No particular words are reported from him for this sitting. There is an hour on Friday in which a Muslim's du'a is answered (al-Bukhari 935); in Muslim 1975 Abu Musa reports that it is "between when the imam sits down until the prayer is finished". So many scholars recommend making du'a quietly, each person for himself, while the imam sits; some scholars criticised that report's chain, and other times are also reported for the hour (e.g. the last hour after 'Asr).
s.ms: Baginda duduk antara dua khutbah (al-Bukhari 920; Muslim 1996). Tiada bacaan khusus yang diriwayatkan daripada Baginda untuk duduk ini. Ada satu saat pada hari Jumaat yang doa seorang Muslim dimakbulkan (al-Bukhari 935); dalam Muslim 1975 Abu Musa meriwayatkan bahawa ia "antara ketika imam duduk hingga selesai solat". Maka ramai ulama menggalakkan berdoa secara perlahan, seorang-seorang, ketika imam duduk; sebahagian ulama mengkritik sanad riwayat itu, dan waktu lain juga diriwayatkan bagi saat itu (cth. saat terakhir selepas Asar).

h.en: "Between when the imam sits down until the prayer is finished"
h.ms: "Antara ketika imam duduk hingga selesai solat"

src: Fiqh IslamOnline: du'a between the two khutbahs (the views, with the hadith)

s.en: Two rak'ahs, recited aloud. He recited Surah al-Jumu'ah and al-Munafiqun (Muslim 2026, 2027), or al-A'la and al-Ghashiyah (Muslim 2028).
s.ms: Dua rakaat, bacaan dikuatkan. Baginda membaca Surah al-Jumu'ah dan al-Munafiqun (Muslim 2026, 2027), atau al-A'la dan al-Ghasyiyah (Muslim 2028).

s.en: "When one of you prays the Jumu'ah, let him pray four after it" (Muslim 2036). The Prophet ﷺ prayed two rak'ahs in his house after it (al-Bukhari 937; Muslim 2040). Then "disperse in the land and seek Allah's bounty" (al-Jumu'ah 62:10).
s.ms: "Apabila seorang daripada kamu solat Jumaat, hendaklah dia solat empat rakaat selepasnya" (Muslim 2036). Nabi ﷺ solat dua rakaat di rumahnya selepasnya (al-Bukhari 937; Muslim 2040). Kemudian "bertebaranlah di muka bumi dan carilah kurnia Allah" (al-Jumu'ah 62:10).

dua.en: Hisn al-Muslim: what to say after completing the prayer
dua.ms: Hisn al-Muslim: bacaan selepas selesai solat
